strongest_angle: Analyzing how corporate reversals on initiatives like Target's 2025 DEI rollback create an authenticity crisis for modern leaders navigating political pressures.

key_facts.fact: In 2025, Target announced it would roll back major elements of its diversity, equity, and inclusion strategy amid intense political pressure.
Authentic leadership emerged in the early 2000s as a theoretical counterpoint to transactional leadership models following corporate scandals.
Google Scholar returns more than five million academic articles discussing the subject of authenticity in leadership.
